details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: [fanfare] The next Festive card that costs 3 or less or Mage card that costs 3 or less you play this turn costs 3 less. If there's a Yukishima, Master Biographer on your field, give your leader [defense]+2.

issues: The cost-reduction filter is incorrect. "Festive card that costs 3 or less or Mage card that costs 3 or less" should not be encoded as `traitsAny: ["Festive", "Mage"]`, because Mage is a card type/trait family and the OR structure matters. Encode the next-play reduction as an OR between (trait Festive, maxCost 3) and (trait Mage, maxCost 3), or otherwise narrow it so it does not match any card with either trait incorrectly.

details.effect: On Evolve: Select an enemy follower with 1 attack or less or 1 defense on the field and banish it.

issues: The On Evolve banish target restriction is incomplete and slightly misencoded. It should select exactly 1 enemy follower with 1 attack or less OR 1 defense or less, not `banishUpTo` with only `maxDef: 1`. Change to a single-target banish with both allowed stat conditions represented if supported.

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Worldreaver's Descent & Dominion of Darkness"
details.effect: Storm. [fanfare] You may put a Naterran Great Tree token onto your field or into your EX area.

options.label: Put a Naterran Great Tree token onto your field
Put a Naterran Great Tree token into your EX area

issues: The Fanfare is optional ('You may put...'), but the parsed `choose` effect forces one of the two options. Encode it as optional by allowing no selection, such as `choose` with `min: 0, max: 1`, or another optional construct that permits declining both field and EX area placement.
